#!/bin/bash
# c5b_pilot retry — runs in screen, with sentinel

GPU=${1:-0}
export CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=$GPU

        --sparsity $sp \
        --strategy all \
        --gpu 0 \
        --output_dir "$OUTPUT_DIR" \

        touch "$OUTPUT_DIR/.failed_${sp}"

    echo "--- sparsity=$sp done $(date -u) ---" | tee -a "$LOG"

done

# Sentinel file for cron

echo "=== c5b retry complete $(date -u) ===" | tee -a "$LOG"
